program.section_heading: Associates in Science Degree Computer Information Systems
outcomes: Identify computer hardware, and diagnose hardware problems
Implement simple algorithms, automate business processes, and visualize data using the Python programming language
Describe network components, protocols, architectures, and the application of current communication and networking technologies.
Determine how to detect and stop security breaches in networks and applications, and help organizations increase awareness of security policies and procedures.
Design a database to meet defined requirements and implement queries in SQL.
Explain the core concepts of the cloud computing paradigm and apply fundamental concepts in cloud infrastructures to understand the tradeoffs in power, efficiency, and cost.
